# Sunofriend support

Use the route that fits the information you need to share:

- Use the beginner first-song or DAW / AI compatibility issue form for a
  reproducible public report.
- Use a normal issue for one independently reproducible code defect.
- Email [hello@sunofriend.com](mailto:hello@sunofriend.com) for private or
  general context. Please allow up to two working days for a reply.
- Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for a vulnerability. Do not disclose it
  in a public issue.

Sunofriend is local-first. Do not send stems, vocals, unreleased music, MIDI,
project files, passwords, access tokens or private review notes. Describe the
problem and share only a minimal, authorised technical excerpt when it is
genuinely needed.

Sunofriend is an independent Unsigned Media Ltd project and is not related to
or affiliated with Suno Inc.
